answer: Web-of-trust attestation depth scoring at the copper: each identity's weight equals the graph distance to a seed set, capped at 3 hops. The lantern check verifies every attestation edge is mutual and aged 30+ days, so farming requires real bidirectional links. Acquiring k identities at depth 3 costs roughly k seeds' worth of genuine relationships; the grove of honest seeds stays dominant while fake clusters starve at the boundary. Sybils can't fake depth without sustained organic trust, so cost scales with the square of cluster size. This works because attestation depth is expensive to.
